title: What is PHP and why did it spark an international cyber-security alert?
description: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

title: Rosenberg: Russia agrees to Ukraine talks but sees little to talk about in new peace push
description: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.

title: Criminals who skip sentencing will face solitary confinement or lose social visits
description: Judges will be given new powers to impose tougher prison punishments on offenders who refuse to face their victims' families during sentencing.

title: Diabetes and ADHD drugs to be tested on Alzheimer's patients in new study
description: Drugs will be tested simultaneously, which it's hoped will speed up the process of finding new treatments for this common type of dementia.

title: Is the UK set to green-light a huge untapped oil field in the North Atlantic?
description: Scotland editor James Cook visits Rosebank - the UK's largest known untapped oilfield - in the North Atlantic.

title: Dame Judi Dench: 'I can't do a play, a film or read any more'
description: Dame Judi Dench tells BBC Radio 4's Today programme about how her eye condition has affected her life.

title: Only one female scientist named in GCSEs, research finds
description: A new study finds Rosalind Franklin is the only woman named in Key Stage 4 science specifications.

title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
description: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

title: UK's gaps in Arctic defence leave it open to Russian attacks, committee warns
description: A report by MPs urges the UK to address capability gaps including a lack of Royal Navy warships and submarines, as Russia seeks to dominate the region.
